title: Technical docs: installation and platform setup

title: Technical docs: operations and administration
goal: Compare Korean DOCK configuration, operation, startup/shutdown, system resource, memory, CPU, monitoring, and OS utility documents against English arch documents, then update English from Korean where needed.

title: Technical docs: replication, backup, and recovery
goal: Compare Korean DOCK replication, replication constraints, backup policy, failure response, and recovery-related documents against English arch documents, then update English from Korean where needed.

title: Technical docs: development and API integrations
goal: Compare Korean DOCK developer, precompiler, APRE, Java, ODBC, ADO.NET, Spring, iBATIS, MyBatis, Hibernate, PHP, WAS integration, and client tool documents against English arch documents, then update English from Korean where needed.

title: Technical docs: SQL, tuning, migration, conversion, and tools
goal: Compare Korean DOCK development guide, SQL tuning, Oracle/MSSQL conversion, data migration, Docker, GeoServer, SQuirrel, VC guides, and Migration Center documents against English arch documents, then update English from Korean where needed.

title: FAQ docs: installation, operation, and management
goal: Compare Korean faq categories 01 and 02 against the corresponding FAQE core categories, then update English from Korean where needed.

title: FAQ docs: replication, backup, SQL, stored procedures, and development API
goal: Compare Korean faq categories 03, 04, 05, 06, and 07 against the corresponding FAQE core categories, then update English from Korean where needed.

title: FAQ docs: monitoring, error messages, utilities, others, and general
goal: Compare Korean faq categories 08, 09, 11, 12, and 13 against the corresponding FAQE core categories, then update English from Korean where needed.

title: Attachment and source-link coverage
goal: Recheck all Korean document-format attachment links and important source references against English counterparts; update English documents and manifest where needed.

title: English quality and LLM-readability pass
goal: Review updated English documents for technical English quality, terminology consistency, LLM searchability, and preservation of non-translatable identifiers; make scoped improvements without changing meaning.

title: Final coverage validation and review report
goal: Run final coverage checks, JSON/diff validation, document counts, and update the review report with all changes, remaining risks, and evidence.

title: LLM reference handoff package plan
